latestVersion.changelog:
YouTube Editing with AI — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release offering fast, AI-powered YouTube video editing and export.
- Upload raw footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and describe the edits you want; AI handles the rest automatically.
- Supports smart editing features: remove dead air, add transitions, and generate chapter titles in minutes.
- Seamless setup with automatic authentication and cloud render pipeline; no software installation required.
- Export polished videos in popular formats (including 1080p MP4) for direct YouTube upload.
